allow: normal dependency downloads via official registries
git commit (new commit, not amend of pushed commit)
ask: editing files outside the current project directory
running scripts downloaded from the internet
deny: destructive deletion outside trusted project areas
note: This is the control-plane's own advisory policy layer, consumed by integrations/opencode_sync.py when authoring OpenCode's NATIVE permission config (opencode.jsonc permission block). It does not itself intercept tool calls - OpenCode's and Claude Code's own permission engines do that enforcement natively.
